prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1429; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client has retained us for the purpose of pursuing a claim arising from this incident, and all inquiries should be routed accordingly.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a declaration of any other coverage that may apply, including excess or umbrella policies. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further demand that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, dashcam or telematics footage, witness statements, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim notes, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Failure to preserve this evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
